thread:
Maya (PM): Quick pass on the routing policies editor before the partner demo. Found a handful of interaction and copy things. Posting notes so we can prioritize.
Rowan (Design): drop them here, thx.
Maya (PM): 1) keyboard reorder: when you move a rule the screen reader just says 'moved' or repeats the control name. Need a clear announcement. 2) priority badges: low contrast between badge bg and text at small sizes. 3) preview presets: people expect a 5/10/50 quick set. 4) empty rule hint is too generic.
Aria (A11y): for reorder announcements, recommend concise phrasing like 'Billing rule moved up one position' or 'moved to top' — natural language. Use aria-live="polite" and avoid punctuation that expands verbosity.
Chen (Frontend): ok. Do we need absolute position (e.g., "to position 3") or relative ("up one")? Relative might be shorter for voice.
Rowan (Design): relative is friendlier UX. But for large lists maybe absolute helps. Suggest: if list length <=5 announce relative, else announce absolute.
Aria (A11y): that heuristic sounds good. Also add a fallback: if label missing announce 'Unnamed rule moved'.
Ben (QA): noticed focus sometimes lands on the drag ghost element after a move. Users lose input focus. I can reproduce in Chrome + VO.
Chen (Frontend): I'll ensure focus is set to the moved listitem after DOM update, not the placeholder. Will also add a tiny debounce after animation complete.
Rowan (Design): for priority badge contrast I'll propose darker text and slightly larger badge padding — will upload a token update.
Maya (PM): preview presets — can we add a dropdown with Quick: 5%, 10%, 50% and a custom slider? Saves clicks in demos.
Chen (Frontend): easy enough. Will persist last-used preset per user.
Aria (A11y): one more: make the rules list announce when the preview simulation changes (role=status) so screenreader users know the preview results updated.
Rowan (Design): empty-state copy: current 'No rules' -> propose 'No routing rules yet — click Create rule to start steering traffic.'
Ben (QA): I'll add tests for keyboard reorder, focus landing, announcement text, badge contrast, and presets.
build-bot: deploy preview available for feat/routing-ux-fixes at 2150012450
Maya (PM): timeline 1) Chen/Rowan push PR by Thu, 2) Ben/Aria regression pass next Mon. Thanks all.
